# The Open Dentistry Journal

> An open access peer-reviewed journal publishing dental research with gold open access, CC-BY 4.0 licensing, and comprehensive editorial standards.

The Open Dentistry Journal is published by Bentham Open and provides a platform for dental researchers to publish original articles, reviews, and thematic issues. The journal maintains rigorous peer-review processes and editorial policies aligned with Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE) standards.

## Key Topics

- Open Access Publishing
- Peer Review
- Dental Research
- CC-BY 4.0 Licensing
- Manuscript Submission
- Editorial Board
- Research Misconduct
- Publishing Ethics
- Conflict of Interest
- Plagiarism Detection
- COPE Guidelines
- Bentham Open
- Scopus Indexing
- Content Integrity
- Journal Policies

## Journal Overview & Access

- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Home Page](https://opendentistryjournal.com/index.php): Open Access dental research journal publishing peer-reviewed articles and reviews
- [The Open Dentistry Journal - About the Journal](https://opendentistryjournal.com/about-the-journal.php): Journal overview covering scope, indexing, submission guidelines, and policies
- [The Open Dentistry Journal - About the Publisher](https://opendentistryjournal.com/about-the-publisher.php): Information about Bentham Open and Bentham Science publishing operations
- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Open Access Policy](https://opendentistryjournal.com/open-access-policy.php): Gold open access policy with CC-BY 4.0 licensing and article processing charges

## Manuscript Submission & Guidelines

- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Submit Papers](https://opendentistryjournal.com/call-for-papers.php): Manuscript submission guidelines for dental research articles and thematic issues
- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Frequently Asked Questions](https://opendentistryjournal.com/frequently-asked-questions.php): FAQs covering manuscript submission, peer-review, MPS system, and copyright
- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Guest Topical Issue Editor(s)](https://opendentistryjournal.com/guest-topical-issue-editor.php): Guest editors for topical issues, including Giorgio Lombardo from University of Verona

## Editorial Leadership

- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Editorial Board](https://opendentistryjournal.com/editorial-board.php): Editorial board members including Ibtisam Al-Hashimi and Frederick C.S. Chu
- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Editorial Management](https://opendentistryjournal.com/editorial-management.php): Editorial board roles, peer-review processes, and editor selection criteria
- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Editorial Policies](https://opendentistryjournal.com/editorial-policies.php): Editorial policies including CC-BY 4.0 licensing, preprint, and conflict-of-interest

## Ethics & Integrity Standards

- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Publishing Ethics](https://opendentistryjournal.com/publishing-ethics.php): Publishing ethics standards covering peer-review, author guidelines, and integrity
- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Research Misconduct](https://opendentistryjournal.com/research-misconduct.php): Research misconduct procedures and complaint handling following COPE standards
- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Conflict of Interest](https://opendentistryjournal.com/conflict-of-interest.php): Author conflict of interest disclosure requirements and institutional conflicts
- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Plagiarism Prevention](https://opendentistryjournal.com/plagiarism-prevention.php): Plagiarism detection using iThenticate software and academic integrity standards
- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Allegations From Whistleblowers](https://opendentistryjournal.com/allegations-from-whistleblowers.php): Whistleblower procedures and ethics policy following COPE guidelines

## Post-Publication Management

- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Fabricating and stating false information](https://opendentistryjournal.com/fabricating-and-stating-false-information.php): Policy on fabricated data, retraction, and correction notice procedures
- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Post Publication Discussions and Corrections](https://opendentistryjournal.com/post-publication-discussions-and-corrections.php): Post-publication corrections, retractions, and editorial concerns following COPE
- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Ensuring Content Integrity](https://opendentistryjournal.com/ensuring-content-integrity.php): Content integrity verification using CrossMark and CrossRef services

## Technical Reference

- [The Open Dentistry Journal - Open URL Guidelines](https://opendentistryjournal.com/open-url-guidelines.php): Technical documentation for OpenURL linking syntax and DOI article access
